briefing.headline: US-China AI compute export controls tighten as frontier labs race toward agentic systems

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The global AI race has intensified with multiple labs releasing advanced reasoning models this month. Regulatory pressure is mounting on export controls while safety concerns around multi-agent deployments grow.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with enhanced long-horizon planning. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus featuring improved constitutional alignment. DeepSeek R2 achieved competitive performance at lower inference cost while Google and xAI continue internal scaling.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming benchmarks highlight risks in autonomous agent swarms.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments accelerating. Microsoft and CoreWeave expanded data center capacity in Texas and Europe. TSMC reports record AI chip orders through Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will coordinated multi-agent systems cross a threshold requiring mandatory protocol-level security standards by 2027?
